title: Visibility change applies at once, empty groups are blocked, members kept
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Owner/Admin user.
  • The Notifications page is open on the Tag groups tab.
  • An active location is selected.
  • A public group (that you will switch to personal).
  • An admin renaming another user's public group.
  • A group whose only member has left the location.
custom_steps:
1. Switch a public group back to personal and confirm it is hidden from everyone but the owner immediately.
  2. As an admin, rename another user's public group and check who still owns it.
  3. Try to create a group with no members, and to empty an existing group and save.
  4. Open a group whose only member left the location and confirm the member is kept until an edit.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Switching a public group back to personal hides it from everyone but its owner immediately; an admin renaming another user's public group does not change who owns it.
  • A group with no members cannot be saved in either direction (it cannot be created empty, and an existing group cannot be emptied).
  • A group whose only member leaves the location keeps that member until someone edits the group (enforced in the dialog, not by a background sweep).

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667; story SV-10249 (S6, Manage tag groups); Notifications Update v1 PRD (Confluence 817463297), S6; design boards TagGroups/Modal; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S6-E1: “Switching a public group back to personal hides it from everyone but its owner immediately.”
  • S6-E3: “An admin renaming another user's public group does not change who owns it.”
  • S6-E4: “A group with no members cannot be saved, in either direction: it cannot be created empty and an existing group cannot be emptied.”
  • S6-E6: “A group whose only member leaves the location keeps that member until someone edits the group. The rule is enforced in the dialog, not by a background sweep.”

Last checked against build v26.40.7-7ffda69 on 10/5/2026.
